output.reason: The PR [ev-5f600c2dbe2c] says the APIEstablisher now merges the desired MRD spec into the existing MRD, so it no longer changes MRD state except when explicitly setting it to Active. This is a fix to the MRD handling added in this same release: the MRD type, the MRD reconciler and CRD-to-MRD conversion all ship in 2.0.0 [ev-47653e3e1ebb][ev-543a22471270][ev-2c984df9c0e9]. So no released version that an environment could upgrade from had the old overwrite behaviour. The proposed undecidable leaf, "existing MRDs overlap provider MRDs", also misdescribes the condition: MRDs are cluster objects whose state is a spec field, not runtime traffic or data. No exposure condition for upgraders follows from the evidence.
